title: Syrian Kebab Delight
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring Syrian kebabs, served with a side of peanut sauce and kissed onions.
instructions: Season the Syrian kebabs with cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the peanuts in a dry pan over medium heat until fragrant.
In a blender or food processor, combine the toasted peanuts, peanut butter, honey, lemon juice, and minced garlic.
Blend until smooth and creamy, adjusting the seasoning as needed.
Caramelize the kissed onions in olive oil over low heat until deep golden brown.
Serve the grilled kebabs with a side of peanut sauce and kissed onions.
Garnish with chopped peanuts and fresh herbs, if desired.
